attacks.name: Silicate Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Throw|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is Size 2 or less, this character may Throw it |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Sand Blast
steps: |*Underfoot|: After each attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, this character Pushes the defender |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Punchin' Your Ticket
steps: Add 2 dice to this attack for each allied |£sand-construct-1-grunts£&*Sand Construct&| within |!range| 2 of the defender.

superPowers.name: Reabsorb
superPowers.body: Choose an allied |£sand-construct-1-grunts£&*Sand Construct&| within |!range| 3 of this character. Place this character within |!range| 1 of the chosen |*Sand Construct|. Then the chosen |*Sand Construct| is KO'd and this character removes 1 |!damage| from itself.

superPowers.name: Create Sand Construct
superPowers.body: You may have 2 |£sand-construct-1-grunts£&*Sand Constructs&| in your Squad instead of the normal 1. You must activate all allied |*Sand Constructs| before this character's Activation.|\|At the start of this character's Activation, if there are fewer than 2 |*Sand Constructs| in play, this character may suffer 2 |!damage|. If it does, place 1 |*Sand Construct| into play within |!range| 2 of this character. It gains an Activated token and is part of your Squad.

superPowers.name: Sand Manipulation
superPowers.body: This character gains 1 |!power| whenever an allied |£sand-construct-1-grunts£&*Sand Construct&| deals |!damage| or suffers |!damage| from an enemy effect.
